arguments.sql: SELECT orders.id, orders.order_date, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS total FROM orders JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id WHERE orders.id = 168 AND orders.customer_id = (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE name = 'Pennant Hydraulics Inc.') GROUP BY orders.id

arguments.subject: Order 168: date received and total
